name: Blackbraid
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level adept 1, bloodrager 1, lathspell 1, magus 1, occultist 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1, unchained summoner 1, witch 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a length of braided black hair)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You point at the creature, the braided hair disappearing from your hand and powerful braids of hair burst forth around the target, trying to entrap them. You make a CMB check against the target using your spellcasting modifier instead of your Strength modifier and no penalties or benefits for size.

If the target breaks the grapple or the grapple attempt fails, the blackbraid attempts the grapple attempt again at the beginning of the target’s next turn. The blackbraid’s CMD is 10 + your spellcasting ability modifier, your Dexterity modifier, and your base attack bonus.
